## selection.set

Replaces the selection of entities (an empty array clears it; selecting entities shows them in the inspector) and/or shows an asset in the asset inspector (asset; null returns to the entities), as clicking it in the Content Browser does. The entities stay selected while an asset is inspected.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorStateCommands.cpp:333`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset` | string or null | no |   | Asset to inspect (handle or path), or null for the entities. |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Entity IDs. |
